properties.description:
The user reports very slow first load and slow actions after loading. Start with the nested Checks view improvement, including joint needs analysis and image-generation rounds before development and a human UI review after it. Then establish representative baseline measurements, identify causes, implement measured improvements, and review the result with the user. Entire scope and every nested scope are sequential.

Cover initial load and interaction latency across the active app, with measurements separating relevant service, data, transport and rendering work as supported by evidence. Agree measurable acceptance goals during analysis; do not invent timing claims. Preserve correctness, state freshness, review rules and evidence. After this stage the user should be able to use the UI to complete work already done and approved without agent assistance.
properties.title: Improve initial loading and UI action performance
